dataRoles.name: invernadero
dataRoles.description: Unique identifier for each object on the canvas (e.g. A01, Table-12, Seat-05)

dataRoles.name: etiqueta
dataRoles.description: Display name shown inside each object. Defaults to Object ID if not set.

dataRoles.name: valorPrincipal
dataRoles.description: Primary numeric value. Drives the fill bar (0-100 = percentage). Optional — leave empty for status-only visuals.

dataRoles.name: campoTexto1
dataRoles.description: Categorical field used by color rules (e.g. Status, State, Category)

dataRoles.name: tooltipFields
dataRoles.description: Additional fields shown in the tooltip — drag any combination of measures, dates, or text fields. Order is preserved.

dataRoles.name: layoutX
dataRoles.description: Horizontal position on canvas (0 to Canvas_W). Set column to Don't Summarize.

dataRoles.name: layoutY
dataRoles.description: Vertical position on canvas (0 to Canvas_H). Set column to Don't Summarize.

dataRoles.name: layoutW
dataRoles.description: Object width in pixels. Set column to Don't Summarize.

dataRoles.name: layoutH
dataRoles.description: Object height in pixels. Set column to Don't Summarize.

dataRoles.name: canvasW
dataRoles.description: Original canvas width from the editor (Canvas_W). Set column to Don't Summarize. Used for accurate aspect ratio.

dataRoles.name: canvasH
dataRoles.description: Original canvas height from the editor (Canvas_H). Set column to Don't Summarize. Used for accurate aspect ratio.

dataRoles.name: imageUrl
dataRoles.description: Public URL of the background image (Image_URL column). Optional — when present, the visual renders the image behind the objects.

dataRoles.name: polygonPoints
dataRoles.description: Polygon vertex list from the editor (Polygon_Points column). Format: 'x,y;x,y;...' in relative 0-100 coordinates. Optional — leave empty for rectangle objects.

dataRoles.name: centroidX
dataRoles.description: Optional. Horizontal position of the label/route anchor as percentage of canvas (0-100). Honors manual overrides set in the editor. Falls back to the bounding-box center when empty. Critical for irregular polygons (L, U, donut shapes) where the bbox center falls outside the silhouette.

dataRoles.name: centroidY
dataRoles.description: Optional. Vertical position of the label/route anchor as percentage of canvas (0-100). See Centroid X.

dataRoles.name: routeOrder
dataRoles.description: Linear route mode: numeric column (1, 2, 3...) indicating the order to visit each object. Set column to Don't Summarize. The visual draws lines connecting centroids in increasing order.

dataRoles.name: routeFrom
dataRoles.description: Graph mode: source object ID for an edge. Used together with Route To to draw arbitrary connections (graphs, networks). Each row in the source table represents one edge.

dataRoles.name: routeTo
dataRoles.description: Graph mode: destination object ID for an edge. Used together with Route From.

dataRoles.name: routeWeight
dataRoles.description: Optional weight/distance/cost for each edge. When bound, line thickness scales proportionally so heavier edges stand out.

reglasJson.description: Internal: color-rule definitions. Edit via the built-in Rules editor (gear icon).

colorFallback.description: Color used when no rule matches

rotation.description: Internal: last selected rotation (persisted across reloads).

backgroundOpacity.description: How visible the background image is behind the shapes (0-100). Lower values let the rule colors stand out more.

showRoutes.description: Draw lines connecting object centroids based on Route Order or Route From/To bindings.

routeThickness.description: Base thickness in pixels (1-10). When Route Weight is bound, scales proportionally.

routeOpacity.description: Line opacity (0-100). Lower values let underlying shapes show through.

showArrows.description: Place arrowheads on segments. Recommended for linear routes (Route Order). Optional for graphs.
